data.message: Fisher23: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others. Each of the other 24: opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gains.
